title: Accountability
definition: Accountability is the loving practice of helping one another walk faithfully before God through honesty, encouragement, correction, confession, and prayer.
summary: Biblical accountability is not control or shame. It is humble partnership for holiness, restoration, and perseverance.
christFocus: Christ shepherds His people through truth and grace, and He uses believers to help one another remain faithful.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Biblical accountability is not control or shame. It is humble partnership for holiness, restoration, and perseverance.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
